best_for: Students and home users who need to open and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files for free, and who can accept AI and extra cloud space being paid extras.
description:
WPS Office is an office suite from Kingsoft, a proprietary product that is free to download. Its maker says it has more than 500 million active users, and the interface is laid out much like Microsoft Office, so most people find their way around quickly.

Documents, spreadsheets, slides and PDFs all open in one window, so you do not need a separate program for each. It handles macro-enabled files such as .docm, .xlsm and .pptm, as well as templates and CSV. WPS says it offers more than 100,000 templates for reports, resumes, invoices and slides. If you sign in with the same account on your phone, tablet or the web, you can pick up a cloud document on your PC where you left off.

points.title: Microsoft formats in, Microsoft formats out
points.text: Writer, Spreadsheet and Presentation open and save .docx, .xlsx and .pptx along with the older .doc, .xls and .ppt, and export to PDF. PDF tools for merging, splitting and reading are part of the suite.

points.title: Free tier has limits
points.text: On the free plan, AI tools such as Chat with PDF, AI Rewrite and AI Slides are marked limited, and paid tiers add more cloud storage. Paid Pro+ also caps AI use per day. The pricing page did not show prices when read on the date below.

points.title: No account to edit
points.text: WPS says you can open, edit and save files without an account. Signing in is needed for sync, online collaboration and some AI services.

points.title: Windows build is per user
points.text: The Windows installer is a small 32-bit (x86) download that installs for the current user. WPS lists 64-bit Windows 10 and 11 as the requirement. The Windows listing keeps 58 versions.

points.title: Linux runs an older line
points.text: The Linux version listed here is 11.1, behind 12.x on Windows and Mac. It is a Flatpak that Flathub does not mark as verified, x64 only, under a proprietary license. WPS also offers .deb and .rpm packages.

points.title: Mac and Linux: current release only
points.text: macOS has separate Intel and Apple silicon builds. macOS and Linux list only the current release, so downgrades there need another source.
